definitions.gloss: generally; commonly; in general; as a rule
definitions.explanation: Used to state what is true in most cases or what most people think or do. A common sentence-level adverb.

examples.japanese: {一般的|いっぱんてき}に⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一般的|いっぱんてき}に⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}いで→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, people generally take off their shoes before entering a house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一般的|いっぱんてき}に⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This disease is generally considered to be more common in elderly people.

notes:
Adverbial form of ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧ (general, common). One of the most frequently used adverbs for making generalizations in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}に⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧: generally speaking
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}に⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: generally speaking (conditional form)
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}に⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: in general (with topic marker for emphasis)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: usually, normally (more casual; describes the default state)
- {大抵|たいてい}: usually, mostly (about frequency)
- ⟦{概|おおむ}ね→概ね：05732_oomune⟧: generally, on the whole (more formal)
- たいがい: generally, usually (slightly colloquial)
